analyst_view.overall: A Baltic meeting in Kaunas between Kauno Žalgiris, last of 36 with 0 points and a 1-11 goal record (0-4 at Brighton, 1-4 at home to Brann, 0-3 at Lugano), and Riga FC, 19th-20th after three 1-1 draws. The big news: Riga parted with coach Adrián Guľa on Sunday and on Tuesday named Frenchman Didier Zanetti, who won the Latvian Cup twice with Auda; he took his first training on Monday and takes charge in Kaunas after barely three days of work, which the numbers cannot see. Both domestic seasons are over (Žalgiris champions in Lithuania, Riga second in Latvia), so neither side has played a competitive game for about three weeks. Riga's long-term absentee Varslavāns is already counted, referee Daniyar Sakhi is in the numbers, and news on lineups was thin.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. Riga play their first game under a new coach after three straight 1-1 draws, and both sides come off a long break, which tends to mean a cautious, rusty game; the numbers can't see either, so I trim to about 2.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners, slightly more for Žalgiris at home. A new Riga coach could change their shape, but I found nothing on how, so I stay at 8.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards and already take a little off for referee Daniyar Sakhi's low record (3.0 in one game). It is a Baltic meeting but not a real rivalry, so I stay at 4.0.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.9 shots, evenly split. The long break and Riga's coaching change could lower the tempo, but Žalgiris need a first point at home and will push, so I stay at 27.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.5 shots on target. Without lineup news for either side and with only Varslavāns out (counted), I stay at 8.5.
